"English requirement summary of earlier user requests: Brand the desktop application Converaid with original logo, application and tray assets, recognizable toolbar and panel, main-toolbar taskbar visibility, existing-profile compatibility, and no upstream auto-update feed unless an explicit fork feed is configured."
acceptance criteria set; areas backend, frontend
independent: Desktop application identity, packaging and update feeds are independent of coding assistant.
touches no other feature
files added: README.md, app/electron/main.ts, app/electron/tray.ts, app/electron/updater.ts, app/electron/windows/WindowManager.ts and 6 more; tests linked: app/tests/updater.test.ts

Reference review found no feature-level dependency on selected-project preparation, prompts or model presets. Branding shares toolbar and panel files with those capabilities without changing their behavior. Compatibility preserves the established local profile and credential identity.

Original assets at c145803: app/build/converaid-icon.ico, converaid-logo.png, converaid-tray.png and converaid-tray-16/32/64/256.png. The release owner inspected every generated image. The ledger link command excludes binary assets from its file index; package.json and docs/converaid-branding.md link their implementation and design references.

Research: Inspected the Electron window, tray, package and updater integration. Kept the established storage/app identity for existing-profile compatibility, introduced original Converaid artwork and visible names, and required an explicit CONVERAID_UPDATE_URL feed rather than inheriting upstream updates. Evidence: app/package.json, electron/main.ts, tray.ts, updater.ts, windows/WindowManager.ts and docs/converaid-branding.md at c145803.

Design: The release owner inspected every original Converaid logo, ICO and tray image and the rendered toolbar/panel screenshots. Desktop 1440 px and approximately 390 px UI smoke passed. The toolbar remains taskbar-visible while auxiliary windows remain excluded, matching the requested desktop discoverability.

Security: Branding preserves compatible profile and credential storage and does not copy secrets into assets or metadata. The packaged app only starts update checks when an explicit fork feed is supplied; updater tests cover the absent-feed boundary. Original image assets and local UI fixtures add no paid calls. An unchanged upstream account/billing error-display issue is recorded separately as a low-severity finding.

Release-owner verification at c145803: Existing verified work reported by the release owner: complete suite 257 passed and 1 skipped, desktop/390 px local UI smoke passed, and every generated image inspected. Source package was already built by the release owner; this bookkeeping task made no new package or delivery claim.

CONV-F1 filed: When account linking or billing browser launch fails, the existing Auto-answer action discards the IPC rejection and shows no user-visible error. CloudSync.linkStart and openWeb do not populate CloudState.error for these failures; the IPC wrapper logs and rethrows only. This unchanged upstream…

CONV-F1 provenance: read-only review confirms the identical Auto-answer catch was already present before c145803 at PanelWindow.tsx:103, blamed to upstream d5d7d4d8 (2026-10-15). Branding moved it to line 110. Central CloudState.error does not cover linkStart/openWeb browser-launch failures, so it is recorded as a low-severity independent billing/sign-in issue rather than accepted as harmless.

Laptop taskbar appearance: Jim confirmed both the updated Converaid toolbar and the blue C in the Windows taskbar after opening the updated Desktop shortcut on MININT-V535CT1. Final visible desktop verification passed.
